scripts.copy:fontawesome: shx cp node_modules/font-awesome/css/font-awesome.min.css public/css && shx cp node_modules/font-awesome/fonts/* public/fonts
scripts.copy:select2: shx cp node_modules/select2/dist/js/select2.min.js public/js/vendor && shx cp node_modules/select2/dist/css/select2.min.css public/css
scripts.copy:bootstrap: shx cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.min.js public/js/vendor && shx cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css public/css
scripts.copy:vendor: npm run copy:bootstrap && npm run copy:jquery && npm run copy:fontawesome && npm run copy:select2
scripts.prebuild: mkdirp public/js/vendor && mkdirp public/fonts && mkdirp public/css
scripts.build: npm run copy:vendor && shx cp -r src/* public
